subject: Intro + quick fit questions before scheduling demo — LumenOps
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@lumenops.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Redwood for embedding & retrieval demo

Hi Neha,

I signed up on the self-serve flow this morning and ran a few quick POCs. We’re evaluating Redwood as an inference layer for our vector search + LLM ranking pipeline and would like to see a short walkthrough focused on: model switching, batching behavior under burst traffic, and cost controls.

Quick context about us:
- Use case: semantic search + answer generation for enterprise knowledge base (support docs + product specs).
- Current traffic: ~120 QPS across search endpoints during business hours, spikes to ~600 QPS for product releases (dayparting across PST).
- Timeline: pilot in May, expect roll to prod in Q3 if latency and cost targets line up.

If possible, can we do a 30-minute demo next week? I’m PST based and generally free 10am–12pm or 3pm–4:30pm Tue–Thu.

Also curious whether you have an example of request-level cost breakdowns per model variant (for our finance folks).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of Platform — LumenOps
attachments: none
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood for embedding & retrieval demo

Hi Sarah — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. I’m Neha on the SDR team; Ben (cc’d) will join the demo for architecture and pricing questions. Before we lock a slot, two quick clarifying questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Traffic shape + dayparting: you mentioned 120 QPS baseline and 600 QPS spikes — are spikes short bursts (minutes) tied to releases, or sustained (hours)? Any weekly pattern (e.g., M-F daytime peak)?

2) Anchor model sizes: are you currently running embeddings and ranking with open models (e.g., Llama2 variants) or a mix of open + smaller commercial endpoints? Knowing typical sequence lengths (avg token per request) helps us prepare an accurate cost example.

3) Security/compliance: will demo attendees include your security team or do you want just product/eng folks initially? We can cover Dedicated/Private options at a high level if needed.

Propose a few 30-min windows (PST):
- Tue Apr 10 — 10:30–11:00am
- Wed Apr 11 — 3:00–3:30pm
- Thu Apr 12 — 11:00–11:30am

If none of those work send over two windows that do and we’ll adapt. I’ll attach a very small token estimate CSV to show how we’d model cost for your profile.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
SDR, Redwood Inference
attachments: estimated_tokens_by_endpoint.csv (preview attached)
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@lumenops.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood for embedding & retrieval demo

Hi Neha — thanks for the quick reply and for the windows. A few answers inline: 

> are spikes short bursts (minutes) tied to releases, or sustained (hours)?
They’re mixed — release-day spikes last 45–120 minutes as we run ingestion + reindexing jobs, but we also see predictable morning/evening peaks M-F with ~2–3 hour high-load windows. Weekend traffic is low.

> anchor model sizes
We’re using open-source models (mostly Llama2-13B for rerank, smaller 3B-ish models for embeddings/proxy scoring). Avg token per request is around 180 input + ~60 output for generation/ranking calls.

> security/compliance attendees
Let’s start with product + platform (2 people), then loop in security if we proceed. We’re sensitive to data retention and on-prem options but not a blocker for pilot.

Any of your proposed slots work for us except Wed 3pm — can we take Tue Apr 10 10:30–11:00am PST instead? If Ben wants a longer slot for pricing talk we can extend to 45 minutes.

Thanks — Sarah
